app.name: HomeStretch
app.partner: Habitat for Humanity of Orange County
app.notFound: The link may be old or mistyped. Start from the home page.

welcome.title: See how close you are to a Habitat home, and exactly what to do next.
welcome.sub: Takes about 4 minutes. Nothing is sent to a credit bureau.
welcome.sampleTitle: Try it with a sample family
welcome.sampleWho: Four people in Santa Ana, $5,200 a month, $1,900 in collections.
welcome.sampleNote: Your own road uses your numbers.
welcome.how1b: Type, tap, or say it out loud in English or Spanish. Scan a pay stub to skip the math.
welcome.how2b: A date, the milestones in between, and the exact moves that bring it closer.
welcome.how3b: Small steps with local help from SparkPoint OC and Habitat OC, saved to a code you can share.
welcome.privacy: Private by default. Habitat OC sees your plan only if you share your code.

flow.inlineReq: Habitat OC requires this. You can keep going, and staff can talk through options with you.

household.title: Tell us about your household
household.sizeHelp: Everyone who will live in the home, including you.
household.inOC: Do you live or work in Orange County?
household.resident: Is everyone applying a US citizen or permanent resident?

income.title: What does your household earn?
income.grossHelp: Before taxes. Include tips and overtime if steady.
income.otherHelp: Child support, a second job, or benefits.
income.scanBody: We read the numbers and fill this in for you. You can edit anything.
income.required: Enter your monthly income to continue.

housing.title: Where you live now
housing.rentHelp: What your household pays, not including utilities.
housing.unsafe: The home has unsafe or unhealthy conditions
housing.unsafeHelp: Mold, broken heat, pests, or repairs the landlord won't make.
housing.required: Enter your rent to continue. Enter 0 if you don't pay rent.

money.title: Your money picture
money.debtsHelp: Leave blank what you don't have.
money.collectionHelp: Debts sent to a collection agency. Enter what you owe.
money.savings: Savings you could put toward a home
money.savingsHelp: Checking, savings, and cash you could set aside.
money.creditHelp: Your best guess is fine. We don't check your credit.
money.creditRequired: Choose how your credit looks to continue.
money.savingsRequired: Enter your savings to continue. Enter 0 if none yet.
money.statementTitle: Upload a bank statement for a sharper plan
money.statementBody: Optional. Your file is used once to fill in this form and is not stored.

result.monthsAway: about {n} months from today, if the plan below holds.
result.oneMonth: about a month from today, if the plan below holds.
result.readyNow: You could start your application now.
result.tooFar: More than 10 years at this pace. The levers below change that.
result.noIncomeTitle: Add income to see a path
result.noIncomeBody: Habitat needs steady income to carry a mortgage. Add your monthly income and we'll draw your road.
result.notEligibleTitle: Some Habitat OC requirements aren't met yet
result.notEligibleBody: Your road is still shown so you can see the rest of the picture. Habitat OC staff can talk through options.
result.leversHelp: Move a slider and watch your date change.
result.lessThanRent: That's {amount} less than you pay now.
result.moreThanRent: That's {amount} more than you pay now, for a home you'd own.
result.sameAsRent: That's about what you pay now, for a home you'd own.
result.aimHelp: Pick an upcoming Habitat OC home. We'll work out what it takes to be ready when it's done.
result.aimNone: No upcoming homes fit a household of {n} right now.
result.aimSolved: To be ready for the {city} {br}-bedroom by {month}, you'd need to put {debt} toward debt and save {save} a month.
result.aimMore: That's {amount} more than you do now.
result.aimLess: That's {amount} less than you do now.
result.aimAlready: You're already on track for the {city} {br}-bedroom by {month}.
result.aimImpossible: The {city} {br}-bedroom finishes in {month}, which is sooner than any plan can get you ready.
result.aimEarliest: The earliest home that works is the {city} {br}-bedroom, done {month}.
result.aimNoneWorks: None of the upcoming homes finish late enough yet. New builds are added through the year.
result.futuresSentence: Over ten years, renting costs {diff} more and leaves you with $0. The Habitat home leaves you with {equity} in equity.
result.futuresSentenceLess: Over ten years, the Habitat home costs {diff} more than renting, and leaves you with {equity} in equity instead of $0.

actions.collections: Put every extra dollar toward the {amount} in collections first. Ask the agency for a pay-for-delete letter.
actions.credit: Keep card balances under 30% of limits and pay every bill on time. SparkPoint OC offers free credit coaching.
actions.creditGood: Keep paying every bill on time. Your credit already meets the bar.
actions.savings: Build savings to {amount} for the down payment and closing costs.
actions.orientation: Sign up for a Habitat OC homeownership orientation.
actions.application: Submit your Habitat OC application with pay stubs and bank statements.
actions.keys: Finish your sweat equity hours and close on your Habitat home.

why.needRent: Your rent is {pct} of income, which qualifies as need.
why.needCrowded: {occupants} people in {bedrooms} bedrooms counts as overcrowded, which qualifies as need.
why.needUnsafe: Unsafe or unhealthy conditions at home qualify as need.
why.noNeed: Your rent is {pct} of income. Habitat needs rent above 30%, overcrowding, or unsafe conditions, so talk with staff about your situation.
why.collectionsFirst: A {amount} collection is the first thing to clear; at {rate}/month that's {n} months, so we front-load it.
why.collectionsStuck: A {amount} collection is the first thing to clear, but no money is going toward it yet. Even $50 a month starts the clock.
why.creditGood: Your credit already meets Habitat's bar, so it doesn't hold up your date.
why.creditBuilding: Building credit takes at least 6 months of on-time payments with cards under 30% of their limits, so credit is ready in month {n}.
why.creditNeedsWork: Credit that needs work takes at least a year of clean history after debts are under control, so credit is ready in month {n}.
why.creditUnknown: We don't know your credit yet, so we plan as if it's building. Pull your free report at annualcreditreport.com this week.
why.savingsHave: You already have the {amount} you need for down payment and closing.
why.savingsPlan: You need {amount} for down payment and closing; at {rate} a month you'll have it in {n} months.
why.savingsFreed: Once your debts are paid, {amount} a month rolls into savings automatically.
why.savingsStuck: You need {amount} for down payment and closing, and nothing is going into savings yet. The savings slider below changes that.
why.bottomSavings: Savings is the slower of the two, so it sets your date.
why.bottomCredit: Credit is the slower of the two, so it sets your date.
why.bottomReady: Nothing stands between you and an application, so your date is now.
why.keys: After you apply, a Habitat home typically takes about 9 months to build and close.
why.collectionsLater: A {amount} collection is the first thing to clear; once your other payments free up money, it clears in month {n}. Extra money toward debt gets there sooner.

planFallback.pullReportDetail: Get all three reports at annualcreditreport.com and note any collections or late payments.
planFallback.callCollectorDetail: Ask for a pay-for-delete agreement in writing before you pay anything.
planFallback.counseling: Book a free credit coaching session
planFallback.counselingDetail: A coach helps you order your debts and set up on-time payments.
planFallback.autoSave: Set up an automatic transfer of {amount} a month
planFallback.autoSaveDetail: Move it the day you get paid. Your goal is {target} for down payment and closing.
planFallback.orientation: Sign up for a Habitat OC orientation
planFallback.orientationDetail: Orientation is required before you apply, and you can go before you're fully ready.
planFallback.documents: Start a folder of pay stubs and bank statements
planFallback.documentsDetail: Keep the last two months of each. Habitat will ask for them when you apply.
planFallback.ueOverdraft: {n} overdraft or returned-payment fees in the last 90 days
planFallback.ueOverdraftDo: Lenders look for 90 days with none. Turn on low-balance alerts and keep a small buffer.
planFallback.ueDeposit: A {amount} deposit on {date} with no clear source
planFallback.ueDepositDo: Lenders will ask where it came from. Write a short letter of explanation and keep any proof.
planFallback.ueLoan: A recurring {amount} payment to {name} that looks like a loan you didn't list
planFallback.ueLoanDo: Add it to your debts so your plan is accurate, or note what it is.

plan.title: Your 90-day plan
plan.error: We couldn't write your plan just now. Here's a basic plan from your numbers.
plan.ueHelp: Things a lender will notice on your bank statement, and what to do about each.
plan.saveHelp: Get a code and a link to come back to this plan on any device.
plan.consent: Habitat OC staff can see your plan only if you share your code at orientation.
plan.saveError: We couldn't save your plan. Check your connection and try again.
plan.notFound: We couldn't find that plan. Check the code or start a new one.

upload.stubDone: Filled in from your pay stub: {employer}, {amount} a month before taxes.
upload.statementDone: Found {debts} recurring payments and {fees} overdraft fees. We filled in what we could; check the numbers.
upload.genericError: Something went wrong reading that file. Type the numbers in instead.
upload.privacy: Your file is used once to fill in this form and is not stored.

letter.editHelp: Edit anything that isn't right. Lenders want it short, specific and signed.
letter.label: Letter of explanation
letter.lenderPlaceholder: Habitat for Humanity of Orange County
letter.name: Your full name

voice.listening: Listening. Say it like you'd tell a friend.

voice.noMic: We couldn't find a microphone. Type what you'd say instead.
voice.noSpeech: We didn't hear anything. Tap the mic and try again, or type it.

handoff.title: Send my plan to a counselor
handoff.sub: A free counselor can help with credit and savings. They get a one-page summary of your plan, and nothing else.
handoff.sparkpoint: Free credit and savings coaching in Santa Ana, in English and Spanish.
handoff.hope: Free one-on-one credit and money coaching, in person or by phone.
handoff.error: We couldn’t send that. Check your connection and try again.

share.help: A picture for your phone or social media. It shows your date, never your money.
share.keysNow: I'm on my way to keys

share.alt: Share card showing your road to keys

keepHome.sub: Know what's wearing out before it breaks, and save a little each month so a repair is never a crisis.

keepHome.timelineSub: When each system will likely need replacing, with typical Orange County costs.
keepHome.timelineEmpty: Add your water heater, roof or heating below to see when each will likely need replacing.
